recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future GenomicStudy focus maintenance should happen in the CG Incubator source rather than in the disabled core source/genomicstudy folder.
issue_request: FHIR-39108 was Published/Persuasive for R5 Clinical Genomics. It requested removing GenomicStudy.analysis.subject and adding GenomicStudy.analysis.focus so a GenomicStudy can be about the patient of record while an analysis can focus on an associated person such as a parent in trio testing.
initial_application: Commit 3b5a7bc6d189cd54845818112be294a2525f320b, linked from Jira through HL7/fhir#2681, replaced GenomicStudy.analysis.subject with GenomicStudy.analysis.focus in the StructureDefinition, search parameter bundle, examples, and narrative guidance. The initial application used the FHIR-39108 resolution table's 0..1 cardinality.
additional_context: FHIR-39109, already represented on the combined branch, immediately followed and made GenomicStudy.analysis.focus 0..* while updating trio examples with multiple Patient/RelatedPerson focus references. Current source/fhir.ini has no active GenomicStudy resource entry after commit fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e removed it from active build lists, and FHIR-54345 confirms current core links should point to the CG Incubator resources.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The residual core GenomicStudy files already contain GenomicStudy.analysis.focus and no longer define or search GenomicStudy.analysis.subject, while the active CG Incubator GenomicStudy artifact also includes analysis.focus with the later 0..* semantics.

related_jiras.note: Same GenomicStudy subject/focus change family; it made analysis.focus repeatable and is already represented on the combined branch.
